name: samais-copilot
description: Samais CoPilot OS — despacho APH com IA assistencial para centrais 192.

scripts.build: vite build && mkdir -p dist/lp && cp lp/index.html dist/lp/index.html && cp -r lp/assets dist/lp/assets && mkdir -p dist/apresentacao-ms && cp apresentacao-ms/index.html dist/apresentacao-ms/index.html
scripts.test: node tests/lint-vetado.mjs && node tests/e2e-cenarios.mjs && node tests/e2e-timer.mjs && node tests/e2e-digitacao.mjs && node tests/e2e-mobile.mjs
scripts.test:operacao: npm run build:operacao && node tests/guarda-operacao.mjs && node tests/smoke-operacao.mjs
